pricing.description: Use a one-time plan for one decision, or Plus to keep tracking saved cities and timing as your plans change.
pricing.disclaimer: ⚠️ **Important**: AI only analyzes cities on your planetary lines. It will not speculate about cities not in your chart. Results are for reference only.
